label: official-code numerical-compatibility checkpoint; frozen 20-input Lagrangian relation-transfer development comparison

checkpoint.selection: final epoch; no test-set best-checkpoint selection

selection.policy: frozen development clean-correct ranks 0-19; historical r3 endpoints reused only for method configuration
selection.denominator: all 20 samples independently at every radius; no solved-only denominator
selection.claim_scope: development mechanism and cost evidence; not a confirmatory holdout

crown.reason: installed backend is not outward rounded; mechanism comparison uses the same plain CROWN call configuration

attack.status_semantics: only a full dynamic-model replayed prediction flip is UNSAFE

guard_ablation.method: tie-safe eta implication over original box

lagrangian_guard_ablation.selection_semantics: each property row may select its strongest complete bound from the frozen grid; every multiplier is fixed over the full input box
lagrangian_guard_ablation.failure_semantics: any incomplete or erroneous grid call fails the entire branch closed

comparison.mechanism_question: with identical per-call CROWN configuration, does relation compilation improve bounds when the full frozen grid is executed?
comparison.budget_question: which complete sample-radius obligations are resolved within the same 60-second total method cutoff?
comparison.overshoot_policy: retain mechanism result and raw timing but mark budget status UNKNOWN_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED

preregistered_interpretation.primary_unit: input sample; five radii are a correlated within-input grid
preregistered_interpretation.no_gain_statement: Under the frozen multiplier protocol and cost budget, Lagrangian compilation added no complete numerical-filter coverage.
preregistered_interpretation.no_gain_attribution_limit: No gain alone does not identify CROWN relaxation, finite-grid search, or intrinsic fixed-multiplier reduction gap.
preregistered_interpretation.holdout_gate: No disjoint holdout is started until this development execution and independent audit are complete.
